context: A dad and his young daughter spend a quiet morning together
purpose: Teach: カレンダー/シャツ/ファミリー/出かける/受け取る/早々/嬉しく/両手

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ひな、おはよう。日曜の朝早々から元気だね。
lines.en: Hina, good morning. You're full of energy this early on a Sunday.
lines.style: Warm fatherly greeting with a gentle, sleepy morning tone.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: パパ、見て!カレンダーに今日マル付けたよ。
lines.en: Papa, look! I put a circle on the calendar for today.
lines.style: Excited high-pitched child voice, bouncing with morning energy.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、今日はファミリーで公園に出かける日だったね。
lines.en: Ah, today's the day our family goes out to the park together.
lines.style: Soft chuckling dad voice, remembering the plan fondly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん!このシャツ着ていい?ピンクのやつ。
lines.en: Yeah! Can I wear this shirt? The pink one.
lines.style: Eager child voice holding up clothing with both hands.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいよ。あ、玄関で宅配便を受け取るから、ちょっと待っててね。
lines.en: Sure. Oh, I need to receive a delivery at the door, so wait a moment.
lines.style: Calm dad voice, briefly distracted by the doorbell.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: なに届いたの?わたしも両手で持ちたい!
lines.en: What arrived? I want to hold it with both hands too!
lines.style: Curious child voice, reaching up eagerly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ひなの新しい絵本だよ。誕生日プレゼント。
lines.en: It's your new picture book. A birthday present.
lines.style: Tender surprise reveal, voice softening with affection.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: わあ!嬉しくて、なんか涙でちゃう…ありがとう、パパ!
lines.en: Wow! I'm so happy I might even cry... thank you, Papa!
lines.style: Tearful joyful child voice, voice trembling with delight.
